disposition.summary: The root-fixed return in1489 does not in general restore the original prescribed-average fiber. The original FULL retained scalar mean is nevertheless exactly equal to its gauge-covariant raw-integral extension evaluated along the source Landau representative. With the common admitted analytic/convex margins and the stated literature kernel, the actual local-score bound, coupling cancellation and metric convolution establish the requested scalar estimate.

findings.claim: The Proposition9 relative Landau field already has the original prescribed averages, and a return fixed at all coarse roots yields the actual U1(V).
findings.finding: The Landau construction normalizes averaged gauge values, not values at coarse roots. Its image need not be in the original prescribed-average fiber. The proposed root-fixed return preserves the average of that image and cannot generally restore the prescribed V.
